priority.summary: Fermi Inc. has issued $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031, with total net proceeds of approximately $416.81 million, which will be used for general corporate purposes. priority.title: SEC filing: 8-K — Fermi Inc. (CURRENT REPORT)
priority.formExplanation: A current report — the form companies use to disclose material events between quarters (deals, leadership changes, results, financings).
priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. Everson's resignation was submitted in a letter, which is attached to the filing as an exhibit, and he did not serve on any committee of the Board at the time of his resignation. The company believes Everson was granted full access to its books and records, except for materials related to pending litigation involving Toby Neugebauer, whom Everson represented on the Board.

Bloomberg Opinion columnist Andy Mukherjee says the country's manufacturing gains may not justify the growing taxpayer subsidies needed to replicate China's success. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Spain Eases Data Center Energy Rules in Win for Big Tech
general.summary: Spain is easing rules for data center power usage after an initial government proposal faced strong industry backlash.

Duke’s Mayo CEO: Our Room for Growth Is Substantial
general.summary: E. Yuri Hermida, CEO of Duke’s Mayo Company, discussed the company’s name change from Sauer Brands as it enters a new growth chapter. After divesting its spice business, the company is centering its identity on Duke’s Mayo, whose heritage and recipe date to 1917, while also owning Mateo’s Gourmet Salsa. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

AirTrunk Secures $3 Billion Green Loan for Sydney Data Center
general.summary: AirTrunk secured a A$4.25 billion ($3 billion) green loan to finance the development of a Sydney data center campus, a signal of confidence in a sector that’s taken a slew of hits in recent weeks.

general.title: Pimco Scoops Up $4 Billion of Massive SpaceX AI Debt Package
general.summary: Pacific Investment Management Co. bought a $4 billion slice of a huge SpaceX financing deal that will help expand its artificial intelligence ambitions, according to people familiar with the matter.

general.title: SVP’s Khosla: Credit Markets Have a Lot of Tail Risk
general.summary: Victor Khosla, Founder and CIO of Strategic Value Partners, discusses headwinds worsening since his previous appearance. While markets have already repriced amid mounting pressure, he says risks remain unusually high: whereas he would normally put the chance of severe tail events at about 5%, he estimates a 20% to 30% chance that such risks could materialize now. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
